Thin-metal-frame eyeglasses worn by a person with short dark hair styled upward and thin facial hair growth along the jawline. The individual has an irregular M-shaped receding hairline, a broad forehead with slight temporal recession, and a prominent brow ridge. The face is round with balanced vertical thirds, a moderately defined jawline, and a rounded chin. The eyebrows are straight and moderately thick. The eyes are almond-shaped with visible upper-lid creases. The nose has a straight dorsum and a rounded tip of moderate projection. The mouth is medium width with a thin upper lip and a fuller lower lip. The ears are average-sized with free lobes and are level with the eye-nose line.
